title: Wholesome Air-Fried Turkish Muffins Kisir
description: A romantic Turkish dish featuring air-fried muffins, wholesome ingredients, and a unique presentation in a hot pot vessel.

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt
ingredients.notes: Non-fat or low-fat yogurt works best.

ingredients.name: Chopped Fresh Dill
ingredients.notes: Use fresh dill for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Chopped Feta Cheese
ingredients.notes: Optional, but recommended for extra flavor.

ingredients.name: Kisir Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of paprika, cumin, and sumac works well.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor.

instructions: Combine muffin mix, Greek yogurt, chopped cucumber, chopped red onion, chopped fresh dill, and chopped feta cheese in a large bowl.
Mix well until a uniform batter forms.
Heat 1-2 tablespoons of olive oil in an air fryer basket at 375°F (190°C).
Add 1-2 muffins to the air fryer basket and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
While the muffins are cooking, prepare the kisir spice blend by mixing paprika, cumin, and sumac in a small bowl.
Once the muffins are cooked, brush them with olive oil and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and kisir spice blend.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining muffins, brushing them with olive oil and seasoning with kisir spice blend.
To assemble the dish, place a few cooked muffins in a hot pot vessel, and drizzle with Zainab's Olive Oil.
Sprinkle kisir spice blend over the muffins, and garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or dill.
For an added touch, garnish with sliced fresh fruits, such as strawberries or blueberries.
Use leftover muffins to make muffin sandwiches or toast for a quick breakfast or snack.
